dialect.detail: NIST CCVS (Cobol Compiler Validation System) test suite, version 4.2 April 1993. Uses placeholder names like XXXXX082/083/055/014 for system-specific values. Program SQ220A tests variable-length sequential file I/O (RECORD IS VARYING IN SIZE FROM 120 TO 151).
evidence: ON-SITE VALIDATION, NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF STD & TECH
RECORD IS VARYING IN SIZE FROM 120 TO 151 CHARACTERS DEPENDING ON RECORD-LENGTH
sequence numbers in columns 1-6 with SQ2204.2 in columns 73-80

purpose.domain_detail: NIST COBOL Compiler Validation System (CCVS) - tests variable-length sequential file handling
purpose.summary: This is a NIST CCVS test program (SQ220A) that validates COBOL 85 variable-length sequential file I/O. It builds a sequential mass storage file with 450 records of two sizes (120 and 151 characters), then reads and validates the records. It also checks the NEXT RECORD clause and RECORD IS VARYING IN SIZE DEPENDING ON behavior.

notable_features: RECORD IS VARYING IN SIZE FROM 120 TO 151 CHARACTERS DEPENDING ON RECORD-LENGTH
Indexed file (RAW-DATA) with RECORD KEY for result logging
XXXXX placeholder tokens for site-specific customization
60 GOTO statements typical of CCVS test harness
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: This is a well-known NIST CCVS test suite file. The sequence numbers in columns 73-80 (SQ2204.2) confirm the file identity. Lines marked with 'P' prefix are conditional (platform-specific) and lines with 'C' are conditional compiler-specific. The source is truncated at 16000 chars but the structure is clear from what is shown.
